allow: PowerShell(if \(Test-Path "build\\app\\outputs\\flutter-apk\\app-debug.apk"\) { Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\("build\\app\\outputs\\flutter-apk\\app-debug.apk"\); $entries = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match "flutter_assets" } | Select-Object -First 20 FullName; $zip.Dispose\(\); $entries } else { Write-Output "APK not found" })

PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\("build\\app\\outputs\\flutter-apk\\app-debug.apk"\); $zip.Entries | Select-Object FullName | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match "flutter" } | Select-Object -First 30; $zip.Dispose\(\))

PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $apkPath = Resolve-Path "build\\app\\outputs\\flutter-apk\\app-debug.apk"; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\($apkPath.Path\); $zip.Entries | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName } | Select-String "flutter" | Select-Object -First 30; $zip.Dispose\(\))
